mission.title: Desperate Measures
mission.description: Ask the Merovingian for help in finding Niobe.

npc.say: We've got to find out what happened. There may still be a chance to save them.
Yes, you've done very well, operative. Now, go run along back to Tyndall, and get your treat for being a good little soldier. We'll be in touch.

phase.briefing: Warrior, there's some more disturbing news regarding Niobe's situation. I'm sending you to our contact, Durer. She'll fill you in.

talk.say: Tyndall sent you? Okay... Well, we've found that the guards who were in the meeting room with Niobe--Camas, Gulf, Banquo, and Tslal--have not jacked out since Anome's ambush. If they were shot down at the meeting, their emergency jackout systems should have kicked in and pulled them out. But that hasn't happened, they haven't reported in inside the Matrix, and there's no activity on their carrier signals. I'm not sure what could have happened to them, or to Niobe, but it isn't looking good.

phase.briefing:
This is very odd. They can't be reached physically, the Machines can't find them, and they can't jack out. It's almost as though they're no longer in the Matrix. But does that mean Niobe is...gone? No! There's got to be an answer to this.
Warrior, our lab has come up with results from the data analysis of the area in Ueno where Niobe was ambushed. Go see what they've got.

enter.say: That's the analysis center. I'm getting some activity in there. Maybe they found something good?

objective.text: Check the analysis results on the computer

done.say: Oh man, that's heavy. What if they just deleted Niobe?

phase.briefing:
Warrior, based on the analysis you reported, intel thinks that the sector Niobe was in might have been partitioned off into a separate construct simulation. We've never heard of anyone being capable of doing something like that, but...it's the only explanation we've been able to come up with. I won't accept that Niobe has been deleted.
Unfortunately, Zion still has little knowledge of how foreign constructs can be accessed, much less located. We know of one program with expertise in this field: the Merovingian's program known as "The Effectuator."
We're going to have to ask the Merovingian for help. Considering the hostilities we've experienced with his organization recently, this could be...awkward. I'm sending you the location of a Merovingian group. Just try to tell them that Zion requests a meeting with the Merovingian.

enter.say: I've got Exile programs in there. You ready? They might be more interested in fighting than talking.

objective.text: Tell the Exile Leader that Zion requests a meeting with the Merovingian

done.say: I guess that's promising, sort of. Get out of there and let's see what Tyndall thinks.

phase.briefing:
It looks like you piqued their interest, {player}. We've been invited to meet a Merovingian representative and state our intentions. I'm sending you the coordinates they gave me.
If they want to know what we'll give them in exchange for their assistance in locating Niobe, tell them that we're open to negotiations on that topic. We don't want to give them carte blanche, but we also aren't sure what will interest them that we can afford to give.

enter.say: I've got some Exile programs in there. Presumably they'll be lovers, not fighters, but you can never tell with these guys.

talk.say:
Oh dear, look what the code dragged in. Tyndall sent you, I suppose? Mm, yes. Perhaps you'd like to tell me what this is about, then.
Niobe? Ah, of course--dear Niobe. She's one of our very favorite Zionites, you know. Terrible if anything happened to her, just terrible. My, my...
I tell you what, human. We'll look into your little problem, and see if we fancy it. We may require some data from you--but you'll be ever so happy to cooperate, won't you? Of course you will. Wonderful.

mission.finish:
I suppose that was as much as we could expect out of the Merovingian's followers, operative. They'll try to get as much as they can out of this deal. We must be very firm with them.
I just hope Niobe is still out there somewhere.
